fact: Agence Ecofin reports Guinea-Bissau connected in March 2023 to its first international submarine fibre-optic cable, Africa Coast to Europe (ACE); landing station not named, international connectivity said to be confined to the coast.

fact: ECOWAS says the six countries of the Amilcar Cabral project currently have only one landing station.
